text: The work done by a force field F along a curve C is computed as:
choices: the scalar line integral of the field's magnitude with respect to arc length
the flux of F across C
the double integral of F over the region bounded by C
the vector line integral of F . dr along C
explanation: Work (circulation) is the vector line integral of F . dr = integral of (F . T) ds, capturing the component of the field along the direction of travel. The scalar line integral of |F| ds instead computes quantities like mass along a wire, not work.
